prompt: Implement merge_intervals(intervals). Given a list of closed intervals [start, end] with start <= end, return their union as a list of disjoint intervals sorted by start. Merge intervals that overlap or share an endpoint. Accept unsorted input, duplicate intervals, negative endpoints, and an empty list. Do not mutate the input.

Implement compare_versions(a, b). Both inputs are nonempty strings of dot-separated nonnegative integer components, with optional leading zeroes in components. Compare components numerically from left to right, treating missing trailing components as zero. Return -1 if a < b, 0 if equal, and 1 if a > b. Do not convert the entire version to a floating-point number. Inputs are valid.

Implement split_escaped(text). Split text on unescaped commas. A backslash escapes exactly the next character, regardless of what it is; remove the escaping backslash and keep that character literally. A final backslash with no next character is kept literally. Preserve empty fields, including at the start or end; empty input returns ['']. Return a list of strings.

Implement topological_order(n, edges). Nodes are integers 0 through n-1. Each directed edge [u, v] requires u to appear before v. Return the lexicographically smallest valid topological ordering as a list; return [] if there is any cycle. Include isolated nodes. Duplicate edges represent the same constraint and must be handled correctly. n is a nonnegative integer and all edge endpoints are valid. Do not mutate the inputs.

Implement lru_results(capacity, operations). Simulate a least-recently-used cache initially empty. Each operation is ['put', key, value] or ['get', key], with integer keys and values. Return the results of get operations only, in order; a missing key returns -1. A successful get and any put make that key most recently used. Updating an existing key must not evict another key. A new put into a full cache evicts the least recently used key. Capacity is nonnegative; capacity zero never stores anything. Do not mutate operations.
